title: Store pickup order ready
description: Let customers know their click-and-collect order is ready at the store, with pickup hours. Utility WhatsApp template for retail.
notes: State the pickup deadline and what to bring. No promotions in the text so it stays utility.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your order *#{{order_id}}* is ready for pickup at {{store_name}}. Please bring a photo ID and collect it by {{date}}. Thank you, and reply here if you need anything.
